description: Create detailed analysis documents for all 6 source repositories plus 2 architecture synthesis documents, based on deep inspection of their source code, READMEs, configs, and directory structures.
steps: Write docs/repository-analysis/paperclip.md analyzing: Paperclip is a TypeScript monorepo (pnpm) with Node.js Express server + React Vite UI. Acts as company/org control plane for AI agents. Features: 116 DB tables (Drizzle ORM, PGlite/PostgreSQL), 60+ API routes, org chart, budgets, governance, heartbeat system, multi-company isolation, agent adapter system (Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw), approval gates, cost tracking, ticket/case system, goal alignment. Key paths: server/ (Express API), ui/ (React+Vite), packages/db/ (Drizzle schema), packages/shared/ (types/validators), packages/adapters/ (agent integrations), cli/ (paperclipai CLI), skills/ (skill catalog). Runtime: Node.js >=20. License: MIT.

Write docs/repository-analysis/opencompany.md analyzing: OpenCompany is a TypeScript+Python hybrid workflow automation platform (n8n-inspired, agent-first). Features: 132 nodes across 27 categories, 20 agent node types, 13 AI providers, visual canvas with React Flow, plugin-based architecture (BaseNode class), durable execution via Temporal, 73 built-in skills, memory with compaction, cost tracking, 12 visual themes. Key paths: server/ (Python FastAPI backend), client/ (React+Vite frontend), server/nodes/ (plugin folders by category), server/services/ (core services), server/skills/ (skill files). Runtime: Python 3.12 + Node.js 22. License: MIT.

Write docs/repository-analysis/praisonai.md analyzing: PraisonAI is a Python multi-package monorepo (9 packages, 3 tiers). Core SDK (praisonaiagents) with Agent abstraction, tools, memory, hooks, guardrails, sandbox, MCP. Features: 5-layer agent stack (Prompt/Context/Harness/Loop/Graph), ExecutionConfig with budget/iteration limits, AgentFlow orchestration (route/parallel/loop/repeat), multiple memory types, knowledge/RAG, approval gates, doom-loop detection, sandbox (Docker/E2B/Modal), handoffs between agents. Key paths: src/praisonai-agents/ (core SDK), src/praisonai-code/ (CLI), src/praisonai-bot/ (bots/gateway), src/praisonai-train/ (fine-tuning), src/praisonai-browser/, src/praisonai-mcp/, src/praisonai-sandbox/, src/praisonai-deploy/. License: MIT.

Write docs/repository-analysis/metagpt.md analyzing: MetaGPT is a Python package for multi-agent software development simulation. Features: role-based agents (ProductManager, Architect, ProjectManager, Engineer, QA), SOP-driven team collaboration, action-based execution, structured outputs (PRDs, designs, code), memory system (brain/longterm/role-zero), RAG support, environment for agent communication, tools (search engines, TTS, code tools), mermaid diagrams, data interpreter. Key paths: metagpt/roles/ (predefined roles), metagpt/actions/ (role actions), metagpt/memory/ (memory implementations), metagpt/tools/ (utilities), metagpt/environment/ (agent communication), metagpt/team.py (team orchestration). Runtime: Python 3.9-3.11. License: MIT.

Write docs/repository-analysis/clawith.md analyzing: Clawith is a multi-tenant enterprise agent platform (Python FastAPI + React). Features: persistent agent identity (soul.md, memory.md), per-agent workspace with sandboxed execution, LangGraph-based execution engine with durable checkpoints, Aware system (focus items + 6 trigger types), Plaza (org knowledge feed), RBAC, channel integrations (Slack/Discord/Feishu), skill discovery from Smithery/ModelScope, org chart with agent collaboration, A2A protocol support, group conversations. Key paths: backend/app/ (FastAPI application), backend/app/services/agent_runtime/ (LangGraph execution), backend/app/models/ (39 SQLModel tables), frontend/ (React+Vite+Tailwind). Runtime: Python 3.12+ / Node.js 20+. License: Apache 2.0.

Write docs/repository-analysis/cronus-ai-company.md analyzing: AI-company (Cronus AI Team OS) is a Python FastAPI + React dashboard that turns Claude Code into a persistent self-managing team. Features: 113 MCP tools across 19 tool modules, cross-session orchestration (fleet downlink, session registry), Memory System v2 (direction layer + episodic layer with BM25 recall), progressive tool-loading governance, workflow/ultracode tracking, ecosystem research platform (42 tools), knowledge layer with reference graph + unified search, task wall, structured meetings (8 templates), 25 agent templates, model governance, safety/guardrails. Key paths: src/aiteam/ (core package), src/aiteam/mcp/tools/ (19 MCP tool modules), src/aiteam/api/ (FastAPI routes), src/aiteam/meeting/ (meeting system), src/aiteam/memory/ (memory v2), dashboard/ (React 19). Runtime: Python 3.11+ / SQLite. License: MIT.

Write docs/architecture/component-matrix.md mapping NEXUS components to source projects with columns: NEXUS Component, Source Project, Existing Implementation, Reuse Strategy, Integration Difficulty, Rewrite Requirement. Cover: Company Control Plane (Paperclip), Workflow Engine (OpenCompany), Agent SDK/Core (PraisonAI), Role/Org Specialization (MetaGPT), External Agent Ecosystem (Clawith), MCP/Persistent Teams (AI-company), Memory System, Tool System, Orchestration, Persistence, APIs, Governance, Self-Evolution (new).

Write docs/architecture/nexus-v1.md with the proposed NEXUS architecture: recommended base, components to reuse/adapt/wrap/rewrite/skip, dependencies, risks, and Phase 1 implementation plan. Structure the doc around the 7 required sections from the task requirements.
